intersight.description:
This dictionary defines if the Intersight Otel Collector is enabled.

Required fields are:
  * `enable`

enable.description: The default value is `false`.  Whether to enable the Intersight Otel Collector.
enable.title: Enable Intersight Otel Collector

intersight.title: Intersight Otel Collector Configuration

nexus.description:
This dictionary defines the Splunk Observability - Cisco Exporter - Nexus Device List.

Required fields are:
  * `device_list`
  * `features`
  * `password`
  * `username`

device_list.description: List of Nexus devices to add to the Cisco Exporter.

items.description: The default value is `198.18.0.1`.  Hostname, IPv4 or IPv6 address.
items.title: Nexus Device

device_list.title: List of Nexus Switches

password.description: The default value is `1`.  The Password for the Nexus Device List.  A number Between 1-64 to denote the variables splunk_observability_nexus_password_[1-64].  i.e. `export splunk_observability_nexus_password_1='cisco123'`.
password.title: Splunk Observability - Nexus Password Identifier

username.description:
The default value is `admin`.  Name of the user to be created on the endpoint. Usernames must be 1 to 28 characters long, start with an alphanumeric character or underscore, use only alphanumeric characters and the special characters `+`, `=`, `.`, `_`, `\`, `-`, cannot be all numeric, and cannot be one of the reserved system account names:
  * `adm`
  * `bin`
  * `daemon`
  * `ftp`
  * `ftpuser`
  * `games`
  * `gdm`
  * `gopher`
  * `halt`
  * `lp`
  * `mail`
  * `mailnull`
  * `man`
  * `mtsuser`
  * `news`
  * `nobody`
  * `root`
  * `rpc`
  * `rpcuser`
  * `san-admin`
  * `shutdown`
  * `sync`
  * `sys`
  * `uucp`
  * `xfs`.
username.title: username

nexus.title: Splunk Observability - Cisco Exporter - Nexus Configuration

nexus.features.description:
This dictionary defines the Splunk Observability - Cisco Exporter - Nexus Device List - Features to collect data from.

Optional fields are:
  * `bgp`
  * `environment`
  * `facts`
  * `interfaces`
  * `optics`

bgp.description: The default value is `false`.  Flag to collect BGP metrics.
bgp.title: BGP Metrics Collection

environment.description: The default value is `false`.  Flag to collect environment metrics.
environment.title: Environment Metrics Collection

facts.description: The default value is `false`.  Flag to collect facts metrics.
facts.title: Facts Metrics Collection

interfaces.description: The default value is `true`.  Flag to collect interface metrics.
interfaces.title: Interface Metrics Collection

optics.description: The default value is `true`.  Flag to collect optics metrics.
optics.title: Optics Metrics Collection

nexus.features.title: Splunk Observability - Cisco Exporter - Nexus - Features

openshift_cluster.description:
This dictionary defines the Splunk Observability - OpenShift Cluster Configuration.

Required fields are:
  * `cluster_name`
  * `environment`

cluster_name.description: The default value is `cluster1`.  The OpenShift Cluster Name.
cluster_name.title: OpenShift Cluster Name

environment.description: The default value is `ai-pods`.  The OpenShift Cluster Environment.  The helm chart will rely on the enviornment varialbe to tag your metrics correctly.  command, your AI infrastructure and platform metrics will lack the necessary tags to group and map telemetry data correctly across your clusters.
environment.title: OpenShift Cluster Environment

openshift_cluster.title: Splunk Observability - OpenShift Cluster Configuration

otel_collector.description:
This dictionary defines the Splunk Observability - Otel Collector Configuration.

Required fields are:
  * `metrics_collection`

Optional fields are:
  * `everpure_flash_arrays`
  * `proxy`
  * `syslog`

everpure_flash_arrays.description:
A list of Everpure FlashArrays to collect metrics from.

Required fields are:
  * `api_token_id`
  * `name`
  * `namespace`
  * `endpoint`
everpure_flash_arrays.title: Everpure FlashArrays

otel_collector.title: Splunk Observability - Otel Collector Configuration

api_token_id.description: The default value is `1`.  The Everpure FlashArray API Token Identifier.  A number Between 1-64 to denote the variables everpure_api_token_[1-64].  i.e. `export everpure_api_token_1='a1234567-abcd-1234-5678-abcdef123456'`.
api_token_id.title: Everpure FlashArray API Token Identifier

endpoint.description: The default value is `my-array.example.com`.  The Hostname or IPv4/IPv6 address for the Everpure FlashArray instance.
endpoint.title: Everpure Flash Array Endpoint

namespace.description: The default value is `purefa`.  The namespace/project of the Everpure FlashArray exporter.
namespace.title: Flash Array Collector Namespace

otel_collector.everpure_flash_arrays.title: Splunk Observability - Otel Collector Configuration - Everpure FlashArrays

otel_collector.metrics_collection.description:
This dictionary defines the Splunk Observability - Otel Collector - Metrics Collection configuration.

Required fields are:
  * `etcd_metrics`
  * `nvidia_gpu_metrics`

Optional fields are:
  * `portworx_metrics`
  * `trident_metrics`

etcd_metrics.description: The default value is `true`.  Flag to collect ETCD platform metrics.
etcd_metrics.title: ETCD Metrics Collection

nvidia_gpu_metrics.description: The default value is `true`.  Flag to collect NVIDIA GPU metrics.
nvidia_gpu_metrics.title: NVIDIA GPU Metrics Collection

portworx_metrics.description: The default value is `false`.  Flag to collect Portworx metrics.
portworx_metrics.title: Portworx Metrics Collection

trident_metrics.description: The default value is `false`.  Flag to collect Trident metrics.
trident_metrics.title: Trident Metrics Collection

otel_collector.metrics_collection.title: Splunk Observability - Otel Collector - Metrics Collection

otel_collector.proxy.description:
This dictionary defines the Splunk Observability - Otel Collector - Proxy Configuration if required.

Required fields are:
  * `https_proxy`
  * `no_proxy`

Optional fields are:
  * `password`
  * `username`

For `no_proxy` we recommend including the following at a minimum:

  * `localhost`
  * `.cluster.local`
  * `.svc.cluster.local`
  * `apps.<cluster_name>.<base_dns_domain>`
  * `.<cluster_name>.<base_dns_domain>`
  * `.<base_dns_domain>`
otel_collector.proxy.title: Splunk Observability - Otel Collector - Proxy Configuration

otel_collector.syslog.description:
This dictionary defines the Splunk Observability - Otel Collector - Syslog Configuration if desired.

Required fields are:
  * `enabled`

Optional fields are:
  * `port`
  * `protocol`

enabled.description: Default value is `false`.  Enable or disable the Splunk Observability - Otel Collector - Syslog configuration.
enabled.title: Enable Syslog

port.description: Default value is `1514`.  The port on which the Splunk Observability - Otel Collector is listening.
port.title: Syslog Port

protocol.description: Default value is `TCP`.  The protocol to use for syslog communication.
protocol.title: Syslog Protocol

otel_collector.syslog.title: Splunk Observability - Otel Collector - Syslog Configuration

splunk_platform.description:
This dictionary defines the Splunk Observability - Otel Collector Configuration.

Required fields are:
  * `endpoint`
  * `token`

Optional fields are:
  * `realm`

endpoint.description: The default value is `https://customer.splunkcloud.com`.  The URL for the Splunk Cloud customer instance.
endpoint.title: Splunk Platform Endpoint URL

index.description:
The default value is `cisco-ai-pods`.  A Splunk platform index is a repository that stores and organizes incoming raw data (logs, metrics, and traces) as searchable, time-stamped events. Administrators configure indexes to control data retention, optimize search performance, and apply role-based access controls.  User-defined Splunk indexes strictly allow only the following characters:

  * Lowercase letters (a-z)
  * Numbers (0-9)
  * Underscores (_)
  * Hyphens (-)

Crucial Naming Rules:
  * No uppercase letters: Index names must be lowercase.
  * Starts with a letter: They cannot begin with an underscore, hyphen, or number.
  * Reserved words: They cannot contain the word "kvstore".
index.title: Splunk Platform Index

token.description: The default value is `1`.  The Splunk Platform Token.  A number Between 1-64 to denote the variables splunk_platform_token_[1-64].  i.e. `export splunk_platform_token_1='a1234567-abcd-1234-5678-abcdef123456'`.
token.title: Splunk Platform Token Identifier

splunk_platform.title: Splunk Observability - Otel Collector Configuration
